title: JobLifecycleEvent
description: data of the SSE events every job can send on GET /jobs/{jobId}/events; the SSE event name is the type (§16). Job kinds add their own events (e.g. chapter: beat_start, sentence).

progress.title: JobProgressEvent
progress.description: event: progress. Units are the job's own (beats, bytes).

etaSec.description: Estimated seconds left; null until there is enough progress to estimate.

step.description: What runs now, e.g. a file name.

paused.title: JobPausedEvent
paused.description: event: paused. Pause takes effect at the job's next checkpoint (beat granularity).

done.title: JobDoneEvent
done.description: event: done. Last event of a successful job; result is job-specific.

error.title: JobErrorEvent
error.description: event: error. Last event of a failed job; code maps to a UI state like ApiError.code.

cancelled.title: JobCancelledEvent
cancelled.description: event: cancelled. Last event of a cancelled job.
